observations: Photo shows a black PS4 console box (front view) on a table; no console body visible.
Two PS4 DualShock 4 controller retail boxes are visible on top of the console box.
On the controller boxes, the text 'DUALSHOCK-4' and 'PS4' are readable; no console model/version is readable from this photo.
No ports, serial number, storage capacity, firmware/version, or game list is shown.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only a PS4 console box and controller boxes; 'slim' model/version is not readable.
Photo 0 shows no console screen, menu, storage, or installed games.

claims.claim: comes with two brand new pads
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows two DualShock-4 retail boxes, but it does not confirm the controllers are inside, unused, or working.

risks.risk: Console model/version may not be PS4 Slim (could be original/Pro or different revision).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console label/serial sticker (back/bottom) showing model number, plus a photo of the console itself (not just the box).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic PS4 bundle with uncertain model (worst-case vs 'slim').

risks.risk: Hacked status and installed games may be false or may not work (account bans, corrupted installs, missing licenses).
risks.proof: Photo/video of the console booting to the home screen and showing the installed games list (or running one game from the library).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed/hacked and games not guaranteed to run (worst-case).

risks.risk: Controllers may not be brand new or may be faulty (drift, dead buttons, charging issues).
risks.proof: Video showing both controllers connected and working: button test + analog stick movement (no drift) + charging indicator.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controllers of unknown condition (worst-case).

risks.risk: Missing essentials (HDMI cable, power cable, controller charging cable, headset, etc.).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out on the floor/table with a checklist (power/HDMI/controller cables).

proof_requests: Clear photos of the actual PS4 console (front/back/side) and the model/serial sticker (model number visible).
Video/photo of the PS4 home screen showing installed games list (and ideally launching one game).
Video of both controllers connected and passing a quick button + analog stick test (no drift).
Photo of all items included (HDMI, power cable, controller charging cable, etc.) laid out.
response.reason: From photo 0, the console model ('slim') and hacked/installed games cannot be verified, and the controllers being truly brand new/working is also not confirmed. Missing decisive proof prevents a safe worst-case price.
